choice.basis: The choropleth legend maps pale yellow to the top of the risk scale (High/100) and dark maroon to the bottom (Low/0). Among the available options, Illinois (IL) is filled pale yellow, Kansas (KS) is filled dark maroon, and Delaware (DE) is filled orange/red. Therefore, Illinois represents the highest risk level among the choices and corresponds to the 'priority follow-up' routing criterion.
choice.option_label: Open Illinois (IL) risk detail for priority follow-up
